thread:
incident-bot: PAGER 🚨 Elevated 5xx rate detected on gateway-prod (nyc region). 3m avg 5xx=6.2% (SLO risk). Paging @oncall-runner. link: https://inc.redwood/2329880246
oncall-runner: ack — on call. I'm on logs and routing.
devin: pulling ingress/model-router logs now. any customer-reported impact? @julie-cs
julie-cs: CS: seeing ~15 tickets from partners hitting embeddings and chat gen with 502/504 between 03:04-03:16 UTC. Not a full outage yet, but several important customers affected.
maya: quick idea — shift a portion of traffic to low-latency model-variant and enable edge throttling for heavy endpoints. low-risk if we keep it 10-30%.
oncall-runner: doing a 20% traffic fallback to model-variant via gateway env flag: `FallbackRatio=0.2`
Command run: ```bash
kubectl set env deploy/gateway FallbackRatio=0.2 -n prod && kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway -n prod
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/gateway-2026-03-15T03:10Z by oncall-runner — 3/6 pods updated.
devin: logs show upstream 502s from model-router with KV cache timeouts/misses. sample: ```
[2026-03-15T03:08:12Z] ERROR model-router: upstream 502, reason=kv-cache-timeout, key=conv-abc123
[2026-03-15T03:08:13Z] WARN kv-cache: miss, latency=210ms
```
maya: that matches telemetry — cache region hitting high tail latency. temporary mitigation: raise KV_CACHE_TIMEOUT_MS to allow slow backends to respond or add small backoff to avoid synchronous spikes. will cost tokens but reduces 5xx.
oncall-runner: patched model-router config: `KV_CACHE_TIMEOUT_MS=100` -> `300` and restarted model-router service.
deploy-bot: model-router restart complete (model-router-prod v3.1.7). healthchecks passing.
devin: metrics update: 5xx dropped to ~1.4% within 6 minutes after the patch + traffic fallback. p50/p95 latency trending down.
julie-cs: CS: ticket volume halved. customers who reported errors now seeing successful retries. noted window of impact 03:04-03:16 UTC. prepping comms.
maya: followups to create: 1) hotfix PR to add backoff+retry on cache miss, 2) runbook update for KV cache incidents, 3) alerts tuning to reduce noisy paging, 4) customer-impact summary.
oncall-runner: assigning action items — @devin please open hotfix PR; @maya please update runbook and write recommended KV cache defaults; @julie-cs prepare customer summary + affected list; @sre-lead will own postmortem. reconvene in #incident-postmortem at 10:00 UTC.
sre-lead: acknowledged and will take postmortem ownership. please include timeline and signal graphs.
devin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/8453 — title: "model-router: exponential backoff on kv-cache misses + better fallback". patch includes metrics and a feature flag to roll back quickly.
maya: alert tuning PR: https://git.redwood/pr/8456 — changes gateway_5xx_rate to use 3m_avg > 5% AND affected_routes > 3 and adds a 1m suppression window to avoid flapping.
julie-cs: customer comms draft in progress, ETA ~2h. I'll include list of affected tenants and event timeline.
oncall-runner: closing pager for now — immediate mitigations succeeded. leaving channel open for followups and docs. :white_check_mark:

Action items (short):
- devin: merge hotfix PR and monitor canary (PR 8453)
- maya: update runbook kv-cache section + recommended timeouts and backoff
- maya: merge alert tuning PR (8456) after runbook aligns
- julie-cs: publish customer-impact summary + notify SLA owners
- sre-lead: own full postmortem and timeline

Notes: impact window ~03:04-03:16 UTC, peak 5xx ~6.2%, reduced to ~1.4% after mitigations. Root cause suspected: KV cache tail latency + synchronous retries causing upstream 502s under specific request patterns.
Please add anything I missed — tagging owners again: @devin @maya @julie-cs @sre-lead
